events.title: Self Defense Class with Underdog Martial Arts
events.description: Join Dirt Skrrts for an hour at Underdog Martial Arts for an informative self defense class with other women to learn basic skills for protecting ourselves.

events.title: September Group Ride + Social
events.description: Lake James State Park + Fonta Flora Trail. All riders must sign up through Eventbrite. Our rides are for all women 18 and older.

events.title: October Group Ride + Social
events.description: Riding in and around Old Fort. Please note that this location does not allow e-bikes. All riders must sign up through Eventbrite. Our rides are for all women 18 and older.

events.title: November Group Ride + Social
events.description: Riding in Pisgah. Please note that this location does not allow e-bikes. Post-ride social is at Oskar Blues Brewery [342 Mountain Industrial Dr, Brevard, NC 28712]. All riders must sign up through Eventbrite. Our rides are for all women 18 and older.

events.title: December Group Ride + Social
events.description: Riding in Hot Springs. Please note that this location does not allow e-bikes. Post-ride social is at Big Pillow Brewing [25-27 N Andrews Avenue, Hot Springs, NC 28743-9231]. All riders must sign up through Eventbrite. Our rides are for all women 18 and older.
